sentences.text: Date : 04.04.2025 Heard Mr. A. Ganguly, learned counsel for the petitioners through virtual mode;

Mr. G. Pegu, learned CGC for the respondent no. 1; Ms. P.R. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel,
Revenue & Disaster Management Department for the Page No.# 7/8 respondent no. 2; Mr. D.
Gogoi, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL for the respondent no. 4; and Mr. N. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 5, 6 & 7.
2.

The case of the petitioners is that while carrying out extension of National Highway no. 515 in the stretch of land from KM 0+800 to KM 27+701 [PKG-1] in the district of Dhemaji, the petitioners'
parcels of land came within the purview of the acquisition process initiated by the respondent authorities under the provisions of the National Highway Act, 1956.
Raising grievance regarding non-receipt of compensation, the petitioners have approached this Court by the instant writ petition.

3. Mr. Gogoi, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL appearing for the respondent no. 4 has submitted that as per preliminary instructions received by him, the petitioners' parcels of land are not within the Right of Way and their parcels of land are not acquired in the process.

He has further submitted Page No.# 1/8 vs The Union Of India And 6 Ors on 4 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35973344/
6 that few of the petitioners have also approached the arbitrator in the meantime.
4. The matter would require consideration.

5. Issue notice, returnable on 07.05.2025.
6.

As Mr. Pegu, learned CGC has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1; Ms. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 2; Mr.
Gogoi, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 4; and Mr. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 5, 6 Page No.# 8/8 & 7, issuance of formal notices to the said respondents stand dispensed with.

The learned counsel for the petitioners shall furnish requisite nos. of extra copies of the writ petition along with annexures to Mr. Pegu, Ms.
Mahanta, Mr. Gogoi and Mr. Goswami within 2 [two] working days from today.

7. The learned counsel for the petitioners shall serve a copy of the writ petition along with the annexures to Mr. C. Baruah, learned Standing Counsel, National Highways Authority of India for service of notice upon the respondent no. 3 within 2 [two] working days from today.
